name: Ramurissa Welgalia
original_name: ラムリッサ・ウェルガリア
source:
She has a loving personality and is adored by the public like a compassionate mother.

She has a gentle, warm beauty and is so youthful and voluptuous that it is hard to believe that she has given birth multiple times.

Her nightlife with King Rokura is intense, and Ramurissa's body is quite developed.

She dotes on her children, especially the youngest, who is raised in a very sweet manner.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=672327&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
